ghost-fill.note: The River socket at 12% (rgb(74 163 223 / .12)), derived from --k-V so it cannot drift from the socket colour. The one standing exception to the Colour-as-Data Rule; the engine draws it from socket_rgb(River) at 0.12.

body.purpose: Base text, tools, buttons and fields. --fs-3; buttons and field labels at 700.

meta.purpose: Row meta, key list, hints and tooltips. --fs-2.

label.purpose: Key caps, sheet foot and off-list meta. --fs-1.

shadows.name: shadow-1
shadows.purpose: Bar, toast, tooltip, callout and stream chip.

shadows.name: shadow-tag
shadows.purpose: Ghost tag (a style.css literal, not tokenised).

shadows.name: glow-ok
shadows.purpose: Compatible edge, standing in for bloom.

shadows.name: glow-bad
shadows.purpose: Incompatible edge. The removal outline uses 8 px at .6.

shadows.name: ring-refusal
shadows.purpose: Refusal ghost tag. The Nothing-fits key uses the same ring at .55.

shadows.name: ring-select
shadows.purpose: Selected row outline (bad on the off list).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one curve for every transition and keyframe.

motion.name: t
motion.purpose: Tool icon nudge; the base duration.

motion.name: t-slow
motion.purpose: Sheet slide, callout fade and refusal pulse.

motion.name: t-toast
motion.purpose: Toast rise and fade, on the 180 ms base step (direction.md: the undo note fades in over 180 ms).

motion.name: tip-delay
motion.purpose: Tooltip hover delay. Immediate on keyboard focus.

motion.name: ghost-breathe
motion.purpose: Ghost cap breathing. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Placed tile rise, per tile data, owned by the engine.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every transition and keyframe becomes an instant cut. Indeterminate progress becomes a full bar at 35%. State still reads by colour, pattern, icon and text. ?still pins motion the same way for captures.

breakpoints.name: narrow-desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Key caps leave the bar for tooltips, tools pad 9 px, the Tiles sheet narrows to 340 px, and row socket hexes narrow to 28 px.

focus.ring: outline: var(--focus-width) solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: var(--focus-offset)
focus.escape: F6 and Shift+F6 cycle focus across visible [data-region] landmarks. Tab is reserved for the Tiles sheet.

narrative.overview:
The HUD is the margin of a survey map sheet laid beside the diorama. Socket kinds are map classes (grass, forest, road, river, beach, ocean), so every tile is keyed by its six edge colours the way a map legend keys its symbols, and the slot the player points at prints its own key: what it needs. The diorama is the hero. The margin frames it in deep survey-blue panels and never competes with it.

Density is that of a legend: small, exact, tabular. One grotesk family (Manrope) carries every role, with tabular figures throughout. Colour splits into three strict jobs. Survey-blue and ink are the paper. One magenta marks the current tool and the current selection. The six socket colours and the ok, bad and caution states appear only as data. Panels sit in the margins (tool bar top left, sheet full height on the right, notes bottom left) so the centre stays clear for the ghost.

The system was written after the build, from `design/ui/legend/style.css` (the owner-approved comp) and `design/ui/legend/screens.css` (the full pass), and moved to the repo root when the overlay shipped (owner Q7). Its sidecar is `.impeccable/design.json`, from which `web/ui/build.mjs` emits the colour, shadow, motion and focus tokens in front of `web/ui/src/hud.css`. The Tiles sheet is open by default, stays open while the player hovers slots, and closes only by Tab or its close control. Tiles that do not fit stay in the list, dimmed with their reason, below every tile that fits. These are owner decisions and bind every later surface.
keyCharacteristics: Deep survey-blue panels on a near-black void, with no glass, no blur and no gradients on chrome.
Six socket colours as the only chromatic vocabulary, always shown as data: edges, codes, keys, mix strips.
One magenta for the current tool and the current selection.
Legality is never colour alone. It is always colour plus pattern (solid, dashed, tick) plus words.
One family, tabular figures, weights from 600 to 800, no uppercase labels.
Every control is at least 44 px tall, ready for touch.

rules.name: The Colour-as-Data Rule
rules.body: Socket colours appear only where they encode a socket: an edge, a code cell, a key mark, a mix-strip segment, a lane, or a tile fill. They never decorate chrome. The one standing exception is `ghost-fill`, which is the River hue at 12% (see Do's and Don'ts).

rules.name: The One Magenta Rule
rules.body: `pick` marks the current tool and the current selection only. Bulldoze takes `bad` instead of magenta, because the active tool there is destructive.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state carries a second channel:

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Manrope carries every role. Hierarchy comes from weight (600, 700 or 800) and the five-step scale, never from a second face, uppercase or tracking.

rules.name: The Narrow-Desktop Rule (1400 px)
rules.body: At 1400 px wide or less, key caps leave the bar and live only in tooltips, tools tighten to 9 px of side padding, the bar's rules to 4 px of margin and the world name to 128 px, the Tiles sheet narrows to 340 px, and row socket hexes narrow to 28 px. The bar and sheet never meet, and the ghost area stays clear (shot `s12-narrow-1280x720`).

rules.name: The F6 Escape Rule
rules.body: Tab belongs to the sheet: it opens and closes Tiles. So F6, and Shift+F6 to go back, moves focus between `[data-region]` landmarks (bar, sheet, toast), skipping closed ones. The sheet foot and the Settings key table both state it.

rules.name: The Paper-and-Ink Rule
rules.body: Raised means a lighter survey blue, never a border or a lighter shadow. Rings appear only as state: the selected row's outline, a refusal tag, or the "Nothing fits" key.

dos: **Do** key every tile, slot and world with the six socket colours in edge order: the code, the key, the mix strip.
**Do** pair every legality colour with a pattern and words: solid for ok; dashed with a cross tick for bad; thin for neutral.
**Do** keep `pick` for the current tool and the current selection only.
**Do** set every text in Manrope with tabular figures, at 12, 13, 14, 16 or 20 px, in weight 600, 700 or 800.
**Do** use ink, at 2 px offset 2 px, for the focus ring on every control (`--focus-ring`, `--focus-width`, `--focus-offset`).
**Do** keep panels in the margins and the centre clear for the ghost, and apply the 1400 px narrow rule.
**Do** give every control a 44 px target (36 px for the small button).
**Do** use dashed strokes for open or unresolved shapes and drop-shadow glow for edge states. Both are native to this world.
donts: **Don't** use a socket colour as decoration on chrome. The only standing exception is `ghost-fill`, the River hue at 12% on the ghost cap, which `design/ui/legend/in-world.md` specifies.
**Don't** mark selection or note tone with a coloured side stripe. Use the 1.5 px full outline for selection and the icon colour for note tone.
**Don't** group the Tiles sheet by category. It groups by consequence: "Fits here" first, then "Doesn't fit here".
**Don't** hide tiles that do not fit. Dim them and state the reason.
**Don't** close the Tiles sheet on slot hover. Only Tab or its close control closes it.
**Don't** add a second family, uppercase labels or tracked-out caps.
**Don't** use glass, backdrop blur or bordered panels. Depth is tonal survey blue plus an ambient shadow.
